condition: If model validation fails and something (e.g. rich/structlog traceback rendering) reprs the half-initialized instance, the repr evaluates computed fields that read missing attributes, so a second AttributeError is raised while the original exception is being handled.
workaround: Make computed_field properties defensive, e.g. use getattr(self, 'version', None) for fields that may be missing, or turn off local-variable rendering in the rich traceback formatter.
